notes: Replace freestanding printed advertising panel with a peaked, framed, divided noticeboard, preserving the original base/support. Other units are valid on separate objects.

spec.ref: the tall gray advertising panel in the middle
spec.payload: a wooden-framed noticeboard with a peaked canopy and two side-by-side glazed display compartments

units.ref_zh: 中间的高灰色广告面板
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将中间的高灰色广告面板替换为一个带尖顶雨篷和两个并排玻璃展示格的木框布告栏。
preserve: 保留原有底座和支撑杆、建筑、人物、其他上衣、石板和远景。
units.reason: Framed divided glazing and peaked canopy create visible structure change rather than changing printed graphics.
